tagline: 理光便携相机，1987 年发布
description: 理光于1987年推出的便携相机。配备Rikenon LensThe operation manual and the official website both state it uses a Rikenon lens, whilst the camera bears Ricoh Lens name on its lens cover. 35mm f/3.5, 4 elements in 3 groups。快门速度Programmed, 1/30 ~ 1/500 sec.。感光度ISO 100 ~ 1000 by DX-code system。Single-point active autofocusing system。

specs.镜头: Rikenon LensThe operation manual and the official website both state it uses a Rikenon lens, whilst the camera bears Ricoh Lens name on its lens cover. 35mm f/3.5, 4 elements in 3 groups
specs.取景器: Albada type, bright-frame, 0.47X, field of view 84%
specs.英文简介: The AF-100 is an autofocus point-and-shoot camera for 35mm film, introduced by Japanese manufacturer Ricoh in 1987.
